product.title: Best ATV Cabo Adventure, Desert & Beach Ride whit Tequila Tasting

description.text: In Cabo San Lucas, this guided ATV outing follows Migrino Desert tracks and Migrino Beach on a single or shared machine. Helmets, goggles, and a bandana are issued after a safety briefing, and a tequila tasting closes the published route. Round-trip transfers cover listed hotels, villas, and the cruise port. A Migrino Park entrance fee and optional collision insurance are collected separately from the listed From price. Drivers need a valid license. The format suits visitors who want a guided off-road window without renting ATVs independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cabo San Lucas, and the itinerary stays on Migrino Desert and Migrino Beach that shape this Pacific-side ride rather than a canyon jeep or camel-safari add-on.
